name: Global Slot Demo

settings.title: Dynamic fiction style
settings.description: Free-form text interpolated into the TypeScript system prompt provider.
settings.default: Follow the user's requested genre and tone.

settings.title: Add fiction prompt block
settings.description: Adds the default fiction-writing guidance block.

settings.title: Replace fiction prompt block
settings.description: Replaces the added block with concise fiction guidance.

settings.title: Update fiction prompt block
settings.description: Updates the block content and priority after add or replace.

settings.title: Disable fiction prompt block
settings.description: Keeps the block in the draft but disables rendering.

settings.title: Remove fiction prompt block
settings.description: Removes the block from the prompt draft. This operation runs last.

settings.title: Disable chapter tool dynamically
settings.description: Disables the demo chapter-writing tool in the same handler that changes the system prompt.

settings.title: Enable continuation demo
settings.description: When enabled, each conversation gets one automatic fiction next-step prompt before the agent stops.

description: Demonstrates UI slots plus agent prompt, skill, tool policy, tool registration, and continuation contributions.
author: Vetta
